errors.evidence: The chart contains two separate data series: a solid blue line and a series of blue dots. The description incorrectly combines them into a single series, stating that the dots are connected by the line.

errors.text_span: В началото на периода (2018) стойността е около 13 000 лв.
errors.evidence: The solid line begins in 2018 at a value of approximately 13,800 лева. The stated value of 'около 13 000 лв.' is a significant underestimation.
The solid line ends in 2022 at a value of approximately 22,500 лева. The stated value of 'около 23 000 лв.' is an overestimation.

errors.text_span: В периода 2019–2020 г. се наблюдава леко спад
errors.evidence: The solid line in the chart is flat between 2019 and 2020, indicating stagnation, not a 'леко спад' (slight decrease).
The description completely fails to mention the existence and trend of the second data series, which is represented by blue dots.
